stories.title: Sheinbaum descarta que detención de alcalde de Juchitán esté relacionada a ataque a Elvis Guerra; es una investigación previa, aclara

en.title: Sheinbaum rules out that detention of Juchitán mayor is related to attack on Elvis Guerra; it is a prior investigation, she clarifies
en.summary: Mexico's president stated at her morning press conference that the arrest of Miguel Sánchez Altamirano resulted from a separate prior investigation unrelated to an attack on Elvis Guerra.

stories.title: Francia gana su primer partido en la era Zidane; Mbappé marcó pero preocupó al salir lesionado

en.title: France wins its first match in the Zidane era; Mbappé scored but was concerning when he left injured
en.summary: France achieved victory in Zinedine Zidane's first match as coach, with Kylian Mbappé scoring but sustaining an injury that forced him to leave the field.

stories.title: Declaran culpable al Manchester City por más de 100 cargos financieros; según prensa europea

en.title: Manchester City found guilty on more than 100 financial charges; according to European press
en.summary: Manchester City was found guilty of over 100 financial violations, with potential sanctions including title stripping, point deductions, and possible Premier League expulsion.

stories.title: Gana Francia en debut de Zidane como su director técnico

en.title: France wins in Zidane's debut as its technical director
en.summary: France defeated Turkey 1-0 in Zinedine Zidane's first match as coach, with Kylian Mbappé scoring before sustaining an injury.

stories.title: Precio del petróleo cae ante dichos de Irán sobre reapertura de Ormuz; analistas ven un "clima tenso" aún

en.title: Oil price falls on Iran statements about Hormuz reopening; analysts see 'tense climate' still
en.summary: Oil prices declined following Iranian comments regarding the potential reopening of the Strait of Hormuz, though analysts caution that tensions remain elevated.

stories.title: Principales ligas europeas aumentan la presión a Gianni Infantino; buscan una reforma de la FIFA

en.title: Major European leagues increase pressure on Gianni Infantino; seek FIFA reform
en.summary: Leading European football leagues are pressuring FIFA President Gianni Infantino and calling for organizational reforms within the international football governing body.

stories.title: Los precios del petróleo cierran con caídas de más de 2% ante esperanza de una reapertura de Ormuz

en.title: Oil prices close with declines exceeding 2% amid hopes for Hormuz reopening
en.summary: Oil prices fell more than two percent on Friday as renewed diplomatic prospects between the United States and Iran for reopening the Strait of Hormuz drove trading activity.

stories.title: Concede juez prisión domiciliaria a Ernesto Ruffo

en.title: Judge grants house arrest to Ernesto Ruffo
en.summary: A judge approved house arrest for Ernesto Ruffo and ordered his transfer from the Altiplano prison to his residence in Ensenada, Baja California, citing health reasons.

stories.title: Ernesto Ruffo saldrá del Altiplano; le conceden prisión domiciliaria

en.title: Ernesto Ruffo to leave Altiplano; granted house arrest
en.summary: Former Baja California governor Ernesto Ruffo has been granted house arrest while facing charges related to allegedly leading a fuel theft network.

stories.title: Manchester City es considerado culpable de 114 infracciones financieras en la Premier League

en.title: Manchester City found guilty of 114 financial rule breaches in Premier League
en.summary: Manchester City was found guilty of 114 out of 115 accusations for violating Premier League financial regulations.

stories.title: Huracán Odalys se fortalece a categoría 4; Polo mantiene lluvias en estados de México

en.title: Hurricane Odalys strengthens to category 4; Polo maintains rainfall in Mexican states
en.summary: Hurricane Odalys reached category 4 strength in the Pacific Ocean while Tropical Storm Polo continues bringing heavy rainfall and strong winds to western Mexican states.

stories.title: Salomón Jara pide desaparecer el Ayuntamiento de Juchitán tras la detención de su alcalde

en.title: Salomón Jara calls for dissolving Juchitán municipality following mayor's arrest
en.summary: The governor announced he would take further action following the arrest of Juchitán's mayor and expressed support for the affected municipality.

stories.title: Nations League: dónde ver el Italia vs. Bélgica y todos los partidos de este viernes 25 de septiembre

en.title: Nations League: where to watch Italy vs. Belgium and all Friday, September 25 matches
en.summary: European national teams face off in the Nations League on Friday across multiple stadiums as the first matchday continues.

stories.title: Riunite va por los jóvenes y convierte al Lambrusco en un rival para la cerveza y el tequila

en.title: Riunite targets young consumers and positions Lambrusco as a competitor to beer and tequila
en.summary: Riunite is marketing Lambrusco wine to younger demographics as their reduced spending on alcohol at home prompts beverage brands to find new consumption occasions, intensified by tax competition between drink categories.

stories.title: Volkswagen y Audi llaman a revisión a más de 2.8 millones de vehículos por fallas

en.title: Volkswagen and Audi recall more than 2.8 million vehicles due to defects
en.summary: Volkswagen and Audi are recalling over 2.8 million vehicles to replace fasteners with more corrosion-resistant bolts, which owners can have installed by driving directly to dealerships.

stories.title: Tu vida digital cabe en WhatsApp: pasas hasta 20 horas al mes en la app y también expones tus datos

en.title: Your digital life fits in WhatsApp: you spend up to 20 hours per month on the app and also expose your data
en.summary: WhatsApp consolidates messaging, work, shopping, and personal data in one platform where users spend significant monthly time, making account security and device protection increasingly important.

stories.title: Adiós al efectivo en México: ¿Por qué el país aún no está listo para pagos solo con tarjeta?

en.title: Goodbye to cash in Mexico: Why is the country not ready yet for card-only payments?
en.summary: Mexico faces obstacles to digital-only payments including millions without internet access, high banking fees, and concerns about increased financial oversight, limiting cashless economy adoption.
